hints.title: Column Height Abstraction
hints.text: Operating on column j colors a prefix of rows from 0 to h-1 black. Only relative heights between adjacent columns trigger white cell scores.

hints.title: Adjacent Column Gain
hints.text: When column j is taller than column j-1, uncovered cells in column j-1 gain score from column j. Symmetrically, when column j-1 is taller, uncovered cells in column j gain score.

hints.title: Column Progression State
hints.text: Track the current column height and whether heights are expanding or contracting to prevent double counting across tripartite peaks.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: State transitions evaluate height pairs across adjacent columns.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining (n+1)^n height configurations produces astronomical search space.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Column DP table collapses dependencies into linear state arrays.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Models grid coloring as column heights and formulates structured state transitions.
